# sreagent_slo (Resource)

A service level objective over one SLI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sreagent_sli" "latency" {
  name     = "checkout latency"
  sli_type = "latency"
  service  = "checkout"
}

resource "sreagent_slo" "latency" {
  name        = "checkout latency"
  sli_id      = sreagent_sli.latency.id
  target      = 99.9
  window_days = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Shown on the SLO pages.
- `sli_id` (String) The indicator. Changing it replaces the SLO.
- `target` (Number) The objective, for example 99.9.

### Optional

- `window_days` (Number) The rolling window; defaults to 30.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status; changed in the app.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# Collections import by id.
terraform import sreagent_slo.latency 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
